title: Define Supersession Semantics for Decision Records
decision: Introduce explicit supersession semantics to replace accepted decision records without rewriting history.
context: As DMP evolves, decisions will change. A formal mechanism is required to preserve causal memory while allowing evolution.
rationale: Supersession ensures decisions evolve through traceable records rather than silent modification.
consequences: Decision history remains immutable while the system maintains a clear notion of the current decision.
alternatives: Use informal references without explicit supersession fields
